season_note: season 2024 = the 2024-25 NBA season; season 2025 is never read

sources.data/stack/oof.duckdb: read_only; oof_predictions: rung0_injury_elo win (P home wins), props_context_residual v1 q_grid at taus 0.05..0.95. Out-of-fold rows exist only for players with a box-score row, so forecasts are conditional on playing. Win-probability orientation check: Brier 0.2144 over 3951 games, season <= 2024.
sources.data/odds/odds_history.duckdb: read_only; the-odds-api DraftKings T-60 snapshots (props main line = most balanced two-sided prices, ties to the lower line; h2h implied_prob is the de-vigged probability)
sources.reports/props_analysis/2026-10-11.json: git HEAD blob sha256 691883eb436dd14e1c76894bc90ead4347fe33d305aaf12cea1d834ee37401ee (parlay_of_day.json; the one live-season file, a committed no-games report with no player or game data)

queries.games: SELECT game_id, game_date, season, home_team, away_team, home_pts, away_pts FROM games WHERE season <= ? AND game_date = ? ORDER BY game_id
queries.box_scores: SELECT game_id, player_id, team_id, minutes, pts, reb, ast, fg3m, starter FROM player_game_stats WHERE game_id IN (SELECT game_id FROM games WHERE season <= ? AND game_date = ?)
queries.win_probability: SELECT game_id, p, made_with_data_through, meta FROM oof_predictions WHERE model = 'rung0_injury_elo' AND target = 'win' AND season <= ? AND game_id = ANY(?)
queries.prop_forecasts: SELECT game_id, player_id, target AS stat, q_grid, mean, made_with_data_through FROM oof_predictions WHERE model = 'props_context_residual' AND model_version = 'v1' AND target IN ('pts','reb','ast','fg3m') AND season <= ? AND game_id = ANY(?)
queries.prop_lines: SELECT game_id, player_id, any_value(player_name) AS player_name, market, point, max(CASE WHEN side = 'over' THEN price_american END) AS over_price, max(CASE WHEN side = 'under' THEN price_american END) AS under_price, max(snapshot_ts) AS snapshot_ts FROM odds_history WHERE season <= ? AND snapshot_kind = 't60' AND book = 'draftkings' AND market IN ('player_points','player_rebounds','player_assists','player_threes') AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND game_id = ANY(?) GROUP BY game_id, player_id, market, point
queries.market_moneyline: SELECT game_id, implied_prob, snapshot_ts FROM odds_history WHERE season <= ? AND snapshot_kind = 't60' AND book = 'draftkings' AND market = 'h2h' AND side = 'home' AND game_id = ANY(?)
queries.schedule: SELECT gameId AS game_id, gameDateTimeUTC AS tip_utc, arenaName AS arena, homeTeam_teamId AS home_id, homeTeam_teamTricode AS home_abbr, homeTeam_teamCity AS home_city, homeTeam_teamName AS home_name, awayTeam_teamId AS away_id, awayTeam_teamTricode AS away_abbr, awayTeam_teamCity AS away_city, awayTeam_teamName AS away_name FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE gameId = ANY(?)
queries.orientation_check: SELECT avg(pow(w.p - CASE WHEN g.home_pts > g.away_pts THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END, 2)) AS brier, count(*) AS n FROM oof_predictions w JOIN games_ref g USING (game_id) WHERE w.model = 'rung0_injury_elo' AND w.target = 'win' AND w.season <= ?

stubs: We do not forecast minutes yet. How long a player really played shows up only as a result.
Prices are DraftKings odds from about an hour before tip, not Kalshi prices.
The parlay-of-the-day card is the engine's real no-parlay state, copied as stored, not recalculated.

The leg breakdown computes every number from stored box scores; the model's chance exists only for points, rebounds, assists and threes. Blocks, steals and every combo show the descriptive breakdown and no model chance.
The breakdown shows no forecast of minutes (none is stored); it shows recent minutes and starting role instead, labelled as such.
Alternate lines have no stored prices; a price appears only on a line the book posted.

queries.games: SELECT game_id, game_date, season, home_team, away_team FROM games WHERE season <= ? AND season >= ? AND game_date <= ? ORDER BY game_date, game_id
queries.box_scores: SELECT b.game_id, b.player_id, b.team_id, b.minutes, b.pts, b.reb, b.ast, b.fg3m, b.stl, b.blk, b.starter FROM player_game_stats b JOIN games g USING (game_id) WHERE g.season <= ? AND g.season >= ? AND g.game_date <= ? AND b.minutes IS NOT NULL AND b.minutes > 0 ORDER BY b.game_id, b.player_id
queries.availability: SELECT player_id, game_id, as_of, status, reason FROM player_availability WHERE game_id = ANY(?) ORDER BY game_id, player_id, as_of
queries.names: SELECT player_id, any_value(player_name) AS player_name FROM odds_history WHERE season <= ? AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND player_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id
queries.teams: SELECT DISTINCT homeTeam_teamId AS team_id, homeTeam_teamTricode AS abbr FROM read_parquet(?)
queries.prices: SELECT game_id, player_id, market, point, max(CASE WHEN side = 'over' THEN price_american END) AS over_price, max(CASE WHEN side = 'under' THEN price_american END) AS under_price, max(snapshot_ts) AS snapshot_ts FROM odds_history WHERE season <= ? AND snapshot_kind = 't60' AND book = 'draftkings' AND market IN ('player_points','player_rebounds','player_assists','player_threes','player_steals') AND player_id IS NOT NULL AND game_id = ANY(?) GROUP BY game_id, player_id, market, point

queries.games: SELECT game_id, home_team, away_team, home_pts, away_pts FROM games WHERE season <= ? AND season >= ? AND game_date <= ?
queries.team: SELECT game_id, team_id, sum(o) AS own_poss, sum(pf) AS pts_for, sum(d) AS opp_poss, sum(pa) AS pts_against FROM ( SELECT game_id, off_team AS team_id, 1 AS o, pts AS pf, 0 AS d, 0 AS pa FROM possessions WHERE game_id = ANY(?) UNION ALL SELECT game_id, def_team AS team_id, 0 AS o, 0 AS pf, 1 AS d, pts AS pa FROM possessions WHERE game_id = ANY(?) ) GROUP BY game_id, team_id
queries.player: SELECT game_id, pid, sum(o) AS own_poss, sum(pf) AS pts_for, sum(d) AS opp_poss, sum(pa) AS pts_against FROM ( SELECT game_id, unnest(off_players) AS pid, 1 AS o, pts AS pf, 0 AS d, 0 AS pa FROM possessions WHERE game_id = ANY(?) UNION ALL SELECT game_id, unnest(def_players) AS pid, 0 AS o, 0 AS pf, 1 AS d, pts AS pa FROM possessions WHERE game_id = ANY(?) ) WHERE pid = ANY(?) GROUP BY game_id, pid
